The fix is complete. The `median` function in `src/stats_utils.py` has been corrected to properly calculate the median for even-length lists by returning the average of the two middle elements instead of just one of them. All tests pass successfully.

**Summary of the fix:**
- **Bug**: When the list had an even number of elements, it returned `s[mid]` (only one middle value) instead of `(s[mid-1] + s[mid]) / 2`
- **Fix**: Changed the return statement to calculate the average of the two middle values for even-length lists
